description.desc_thousand_char: TPAC Packaging India Private Limited (TPIPL), as per its annual filings, is engaged in manufacturing articles of packaging goods of plastics, stoppers, lids, caps, and other closures of plastics. It is also engaged in manufacturing and selling PET preforms and bottles. As per its credit rating report, it is a subsidiary of Thai Plaspac Public Company Ltd. (Thai Plaspac), which is a Thailand-based plastic manufacturing company listed on the Bangkok Stock Exchange. In order to enter the Indian market, Thai Plaspac created its subsidiary company in India – TPAC Packaging India Pvt Ltd in October 2017. TPIPL  had acquired the operations of an Indian Company named Sunrise Containers Ltd, which was in a similar line of business. It has five manufacturing facilities located at Silvassa, Dadra (Dadra and Nagar Haveli), Haridwar (two plants) (Uttarakhand), and Umbergaon (Gujarat). It offers fridge bottles (sunfit, aqua, crown, cherry, frozen).
